messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Last piece for cobalt: the quota service. Every tenant gets request quotas and burst protection.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Proposal: a token bucket per tenant, refill at the plan rate, burst capped at 2x the rate.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: And the default quota: 600 requests per minute per tenant, configurable per plan. Starter plan 10k requests per day.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Lock both defaults: 600 per minute, and starter at 10k per day.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Bucket size is the burst capacity. Tentatively 100 tokens, pending the load test.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Run the load test, then we lock it.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Load test result: bucket size 120 gives 12% fewer 429s at peak with the same average load.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: So bucket size is 120, confirmed.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Noted: 120-token burst bucket, refill at plan rate.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Billing update: starter daily quota drops from 10k to 5k, effective November 3.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Updated: starter is 5k per day, effective November 3.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: 429 budget check: with the new quotas, peak compliance holds.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: If we lifted all limits and just billed overage, would that be simpler?

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Simpler and broke by Friday. No.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Should we revisit the third-party gateway product we proposed last sprint?

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: No: cost, and we lose our custom logic. Stay in-house.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Agreed, rejected: we keep the in-house limiter.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Postmortem from last month: the limiter died and, because it failed closed, every request was denied. We need fail-open with alerting.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Lesson: the limiter must fail open and page us, never fail closed.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Fail-open plus paging goes into the limiter design.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: @lead please record this as a project rule: every quota reduction must notify affected tenants seven days in advance.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Recorded: every quota reduction must notify affected tenants seven days in advance.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: I will build the tenant-facing notice template.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Also, quota reports to me: one-page summary first, details after.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Understood: summary first, details after.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Quota check: 600 per minute default confirmed across plans.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: What is the 429 response format?

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Standard error envelope plus a Retry-After header.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Staging tests pass for the envelope.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: November 3 is the starter change; put it on the calendar.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: On the calendar; notices go out October 27.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Perfect. That wraps the quota service design.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Docs updated.
